chips.title: Choose the game edition for companion reports
chips.summary: Let quest and character reports select a game edition and refuse a missing match instead of reading another edition.

evidence.message: Repository review found that reports always select the newest snapshot across game editions. The board has no prior steps.
Board and status passed Dias validation. Implementing edition filtering with synthetic multi-edition tests.
Edition filtering and refusal cases are implemented and documented. All 111 tests passed on Windows using synthetic snapshots.
Next session should plan live addon verification with the operator. Game-client behavior remains unverified; the panel and journal are still planned.
Saved and pushed as commit 515c967. Windows and Linux CI passed. The leak check passed; live game verification remains outstanding.

chips.title: Check the first real addon snapshot
chips.summary: Add a read-only check command and client build info so the first in-game reload reports which addon assumptions held, with no identity in the output.

evidence.message: Repository review: live verification is next but needs the operator in game. This builds the tool that turns that reload into a checklist result.
Board and status passed Dias validation. Implementing the check command, addon client info, synthetic tests, and docs.
check-snapshot command, addon 0.4.0 client info, and docs shipped as commit bf62989. 119 tests passed on Windows with synthetic fixtures; leak check clean; pushed to main.
Next: the operator installs the addon, reloads once in game, and runs check-snapshot. Its output decides the .toc fix and whether Forever lists quests to pick up.

Operator enabled addon 0.4.0 and reloaded Classic Forever beta on Windows. Client 1.60.1 build 70338 confirmed interface 16001; all 13 snapshot checks passed. Quest and character reports returned successfully without warnings. Available-quest coverage and comparison with the in-game display remain unverified. No real snapshot or identity was committed.

chips.title: Interactive chat window linked to a live CLI session
chips.summary: Add a companion chat window that attaches to a currently running CLI terminal session, so the player talks to the live agent from the second screen.

evidence.message: Operator request on 2026-10-10: make this the first planned feature. Open before work starts: which CLI session it attaches to and how it is discovered.
Operator chose both CLIs, Codex push first, with a session picker. Building the native chat window and a local Claude polling inbox.
Native chat, Codex queue delivery, Claude polling, and docs implemented. All 154 Windows tests passed; synthetic UI visually checked; live chat round trip unverified.
